question.text: Per the NISM-XXI-B workbook attribution decomposition, which of the following is NOT one of the listed attribution effects but is instead discussed separately as a return adjustment?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook's attribution decomposition lists asset allocation, asset selection, and the interactive effect as the components of active return. Currency return adjustment is treated separately as a return adjustment, not as one of the attribution effects. The Trap: Currency adjustments are relevant to global portfolios but, in the NISM workbook, are presented outside the attribution decomposition itself. Note: Per NISM-XXI-B workbook (p.175 and p.383-384).
